[quote=pantagruel;59916001]~750 words for my word debt

[b]BREAKING NEWS: KIM JUNG UN ASSASSINATED - MARTIAL LAW DECLARED[/b]

[pre]Pantagrueli State Media | The Daily Bird | Dictator Watch[/pre]

[i]On July 12th at midnight, the Dictator and Supreme Leader of Pantagruel was reported dead at his palace. According to multiple sources, the leader may have been deceased for several days before the announcement was made public. The cause of death has not been confirmed, and unverified reports have suggested the possibility of foul play or assassination.

Following the announcement, Minister of Defence Hyon Yong Chul assumed control of the government and declared martial law across all 36 continental provinces of Pantagruel. The Persephone Island Archipelago has been excluded from this directive.[/i]

[spoiler= [u][b]July 12st, 2025
Synchrosia, Pantagruel[/b][/u]] 
[i]An era has ended.

Thousands gather around the snow spangled city center, men bow their heads, women weep and let out songs of mourning, and children cry uncontrollably. But it is all fake. Every single soul within the city center is constantly watched by the Secret Police, a man who sheds less tears than the others is taken away. People feel as if there's a mourning quota they must meet.  Everybody is on edge, the future of the country is unknown. 

Within the crowd was the Minister of Defence Hyun Yong Chul, he looked at Kim's coffin with a grim expression on his face. But this act was all a veil, Chul saw an opportunity, he saw power. And Chul's thirst for power was unquenchable. 

"Defender of the Iron Realm Chul, the Communist Party requests your attendance." A soldier said behind him.

Chul gave the man a sceptical look before giving a hesitant nod. He followed the man who escorted him into an armoured vehicle, where they'd take a 2 hour commute to the PCP Headquarters. A golden marble embedded complex of pillars and maple doors. 

Chul was confused, why would they request him in this of all times? But he didnt have time to answer his questions, they had finally reached the meeting room of the party. The guard didnt follow Chul into the meeting room, due to its extreme covertness of manners. 

Within the room was a large round table with 18 seats, though 17 seats were already occupied. The men seated at the round table looked at him, some faces showed suspicious while others were emotionless. Nonetheless Chul had no time to analyze the room, he took the unoccupied seat and traversed his gaze through all of the faces of the attendees. 

Minister of Defence Hyun Yong Chul, we have important information to tell you. The man infront of the roundtable stated, Chul turned all of his attention towards him. 

Proceed.

Weve figured out who was responsible for the death of Kim, it was the Federalist Order. The one youve failed to get rid of for months, and because of your incompetence Kim is dead. We wouldve killed you, but due to how terrible of a leader Kim was, we need you alive to seize power. The man said sternly, Chul felt relieved when he figured out theyd be letting him live to do their bidding. 

What do you want me to do? The country is in shambles and the Federalist Order has been off the radar for months. This war were fighting is unwinna-

No it isnt. The man interrupted

Chul gasped, he really couldnt take what this man was saying seriously. Did he actually believe that they had a chance to win this? After all the failed attacks and assasination attempts? Was he crazy?

We have one way, the man continued after months of ferocious searching by actual competent forces. Weve found where theyll be regrouping. 

What?! Chul was shocked, and youve havent told me after all this time?! He accused, he couldnt understand why the official had done this. 

Its because if we told you any earlier, you wouldve foiled the attack. Pantagruel is at its weakest point, while you are at your strongest. Take your men, go to Ironclad, and destroy them once and for all. The price of error will be your life, and your familys too. 

Chul couldnt take it anymore, he barged out the room stopping his feet on the ground like a giant. He couldnt believe what was going to happen if he failed. No, he could not fail. The order must be annihilated, Aerial must die. The end is now. [/i][/spoiler]
